project.name: ApexOps — Notes SSOT, Phase 4
project.description: Drop Note.checklistItems. The todos moved to the tasks table in Phase 1; the column has been carried read-only since, and Phase 3.5 deleted its last reader (useDailyTodos.ts). This removes the column and everything still shaped around it.

house_mechanics.schema_changes: prisma db push — this repo has NO migrations directory; `migrate dev` would offer to reset a populated database
house_mechanics.prisma_generate: stop the :3000 dev server first, or generate fails with EPERM on Windows
house_mechanics.gates: client: typecheck lint test build | server: typecheck test build
house_mechanics.ci_triggers: pull_request and push to main only — a pushed feature branch runs nothing

features.description: The drop is safe: nothing reads the column, and no row still holds unmigrated todos
steps: Grep the tree for every reader of checklistItems / checklist_items and list them before touching any
Count notes whose checklistItems is a non-empty array, in the actual database
For any such note, compare its normalized todos against its Task rows and report what is missing
FAILURE CASE: if a single todo exists that has no Task row, STOP and say so rather than dropping the column
Evidence is written down BEFORE any removal, so the decision can be re-checked later
features.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-21, before anything was removed. Readers found by grep: server api/notes.ts (formatNote, POST destructure + create data, update whitelist), both zod schemas, lib/legacyTodos.ts, scripts/migrate-todos-to-tasks.ts; client services/notes.ts (create payload + both param types), types/notes.ts, utils/mockData.ts, lib/dailyTodos.ts (normalizeTodos/serializeTodos). Database: 8 notes, ZERO with a non-empty checklistItems — every row holds exactly [], the column default — and zero todos missing a Task row. The column contents were dumped to a backup file before the drop even though all of it was empty.

features.description: The API stops accepting, persisting and returning checklistItems — without breaking a client that still sends it
steps: formatNote no longer emits a checklistItems key
POST /api/notes ignores the field instead of writing it
PUT/PATCH's updatable-field whitelist no longer contains it
Both zod schemas drop the field
FAILURE CASE: an old client that still posts checklistItems gets a 201 and a real note — not a 500 and not a validation error
features.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-21 against the running API. GET /api/notes -> 200 and the response keys are id, userId, title, content, contentRich, type, isPinned, color, tags, imageUrl, linkUrl, quote, scheduledFor, dueDate, createdAt, updatedAt — no checklistItems. FAILURE CASE observed: POST /api/notes carrying checklistItems: [{text,checked}] returned 201 with a real note (id 42) and no checklistItems in the response. That works because neither zod object is .strict(), which is now stated in a comment where someone would otherwise be tempted to add it.

features.description: The client stops sending and typing a column that no longer exists
steps: services/notes.ts no longer sends checklistItems on create, and its param type drops the field
types/notes.ts drops the field
utils/mockData.ts no longer fabricates it
lib/dailyTodos.ts loses the two functions that exist only to read and write that JSON shape
FAILURE CASE: nothing else imported those two — checked by grep to a fixpoint, not by assumption
features.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-21. services/notes.ts stopped sending the field and dropped it from both param types; types/notes.ts and mockData.ts dropped it; lib/dailyTodos.ts lost normalizeTodos and serializeTodos, and with them the legacyId/slug/asString/asIsoOrNull helpers that existed only to serve them. Their 9 test assertions went too — a test for a function that no longer exists is not coverage. Grep to a fixpoint first: normalizeTodos and serializeTodos had 0 callers outside the module and its test.

features.description: The column is gone from the schema and from the database
steps: checklistItems is removed from schema.prisma
prisma db push applied, with the dev server stopped first (EPERM)
information_schema.columns no longer lists notes.checklist_items
The Prisma client is regenerated and the server typechecks with no reference to the field
FAILURE CASE: the pushed change is confirmed to be exactly one DROP COLUMN — nothing else in the notes table moved
features.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-21. schema.prisma lost the field; prisma db push refused the first time (it counts NULLs, not empties, and reported '8 non-null values'), which is why the backup was taken before re-running with --accept-data-loss. information_schema now lists 16 columns on notes and checklist_items is not among them; every other column is present. Prisma client regenerated, server tsc clean. The dev server was stopped first — prisma generate hits EPERM on Windows otherwise — and restarted afterwards.

features.description: The one-shot migration is retired in the same change, and the ordering requirement is written where the next person will read it
steps: scripts/migrate-todos-to-tasks.ts is removed — it reads a column that no longer exists, so leaving it is a script that fails at runtime
lib/legacyTodos.ts and its test go with it, as the only consumer is that script
package.json has no orphaned script entry pointing at the removed file
The blueprint states plainly: run the Phase 1 migration BEFORE deploying Phase 4, or unmigrated todos are unrecoverable
FAILURE CASE: grep proves no import of legacyTodos survives anywhere
features.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-21. scripts/migrate-todos-to-tasks.ts, lib/legacyTodos.ts and legacyTodos.test.ts are deleted: the script reads a column that no longer exists, so keeping it would leave a script that fails at runtime rather than a safety net. No package.json entry pointed at it and no doc referenced it by name. The ordering requirement it creates is now stated in the blueprint under 'phase-4-ordering': run the Phase 1 migration BEFORE deploying Phase 4, and if the script is genuinely needed, check out the commit before this one.

features.description: The surfaces that used to depend on the column still work
steps: /notes creates a note and it appears with its text
/notes edits a note and the change persists
/tasks lists tasks and toggling one persists
GET /api/notes carries no checklistItems key in the response body
FAILURE CASE: none of the above throws a 500 from a stale Prisma client
features.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-21 in the browser against the real database. /notes rendered both notes with no error; editing a note's title through the dialog persisted (confirmed by re-fetching the row). /tasks added a task, toggled it done, and the API confirmed checked: true with a completedAt. GET /api/notes carried no checklistItems key. Nothing threw a 500 from a stale Prisma client. Probe rows were deleted afterwards.

features.description: Both workspaces clean, and the docs say what happened
steps: client: tsc, eslint, tests, build
server: tsc, tests, build
The blueprint's phase table marks Phase 4 done with the date and the evidence
The Note model comment that promised removal in Phase 4 is gone with the field it described
features.notes: VERIFIED 2026-08-21. client: tsc, eslint, 111 tests, build clean. server: tsc, 95 tests, build clean. Test counts fell by 9 (client) and 14 (server) because the suites for the removed functions went with them. The blueprint's phase table marks Phase 4 done with the evidence, and the Task model's comment promising removal 'once nothing reads it' was rewritten to say it happened.
